card.title: MARIVELES
card.text: Mariveles is a small port town on the south coast of the Bataan Peninsula.

value.value: The old Spanish island fortress Corregidor is now all that stands between us and full control of the Philippines. The defenders are few and isolated, but you can expect fierce resistance all the same.

value.value: We are sending you a strong unit to storm the beaches.

value.value: We have finally established a beachhead on Corregidor. Our snipers have been very effective in keeping the enemy defenders at bay.
